HashCore Proxy

Learn More
This Stratum proxy stands out for its exceptional reliability and flexibility. It allows fine-tuned traffic routing from miners to the pool, efficient traffic aggregation, and intelligent distribution of mining across multiple pools in precise proportions. This product is widely recognized for optimizing network flows and improving connection stability. 

Traffic aggregation

Aggregates stratum traffic from all connected miners, compresses it, and sends it to the pool as a single stream

Multipool distribution

Supports multiple pools simultaneously and allows precise allocation of computing power across them

Reduced network load

By aggregating requests and responses, overall traffic is reduced by up to 95%, lowering network costs and pool infrastructure load

Monitoring and control

Built-in monitoring tools track connection status, miner statistics, hashrate, and pool distribution

Easy installation

Supports popular protocols, includes detailed documentation, and a user-friendly configurator for quick setup even without deep technical knowledge

Intelligent Stability

Automatic pool switching during failures, connection recovery, and load balancing. The system remains stable even with an unstable internet connection.
